BAKED LEMON SALMON
By: Mitko Dzhordzhev
Published: Friday, August 4, 2017 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




350 salmon fillets with skin
1 onion
2 tbsp parsley
2 tbsp basil
1 tsp dried dill
1 tbsp lemon zest
1 tbsp olive oil
1 pinch sea or himalayan salt

Preparation

1 Chop the onion,parsley,basil into thin pieces.Combine them with the seasonings and lemon zest in a bowl. 2 Add the olive oil and mix everything to make something like a paste. 3 Grease a baking dish and place the salmon fillets in it. 4 Spread the paste over the fillets. 5 Bake for about 25-30 min until it's ready. 6 Remove from the oven,cut into 2 portions,season with some salt and serve. 7 Enjoy the tasty flavor.

About

The salmon is perfect source of protein.Everyone likes her for the delicious flavor.She can be made really easy.She also contains Omega-3 fatty acids which are really important for our health.This is one,really easy recipe for baked salmon with lemon flavor and seasonings.I prefer basil,parsley and dill,but you can use any other,if you want.You can also add fresh lemon juice for stronger flavor.For result,you will have juicy and tasty salmon fillets.Enjoy them!
